title: VIXEN build wrapper must resolve its worktree root before invoking build-wsl.sh
body: The queued build was admitted but failed before compilation because build-wsl.sh is at the worktree root and the lane invoked it from VIXEN/. Suggested consolidation: make the wrapper resolve its own repository root or publish an unambiguous cwd contract.

title: GPU queue admission must serialize long multi-frame Dozen lookdev captures per device
body: Four concurrent resource=gpu Dozen lookdev capture jobs reached Vulkan device teardown with vkDestroyBuffer: Invalid device/SIGABRT; running the same four states serially, one process at a time, passed. The GPU queue needs an explicit per-device exclusive or multi-frame-capture admission contract so queueing cannot overlap incompatible DZN device lifetimes.

title: VIXEN sanitizer submit-test builds need supported CMake presets and warning policy
body: No repository-owned sanitizer preset was available for submit-test validation. I manually configured separate ASan and TSan CMake trees; the first ASan configuration failed because third-party Gaia/GLM maybe-uninitialized diagnostics were promoted by -Werror, then passed only after adding -Wno-error=maybe-uninitialized. Provide supported sanitizer presets/targets and an explicit third-party warning policy.

title: Queued GPU benchmark admission should expose or recover memory-token stalls
body: A queued resource=gpu timing invocation using --gpu-benchmark remained in memory-or-tokens admission for more than five minutes with no payload output; the same timing command admitted and passed after removing the optional benchmark flag. The queue should expose the blocking holder/diagnostic and provide a supported recovery or fallback contract for benchmark jobs.
